title: India's 1st Model Border Village Foundation Laid at Chumur (Ladakh) Under VVP
summary: LG Vinai Kumar Saxena inaugurates 1st of 10 model border villages at 16,700 feet altitude.

blocks.content: LG Vinai Kumar Saxena inaugurates 1st of 10 model border villages at 16,700 feet altitude.

items: Vibrant Village Model: Chumur village (24 households) developed under 4 pillars: Infrastructure, Livelihoods, All-Weather, and Defence Integration.
Climate Housing: Construction of 24 passive solar, thermally insulated houses with homestay facilities.
Border Altitude: Situated at 16,700 feet along the India-China border.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Vibrant Villages Programme (VVP) launched in 2023 for northern border development.
